# Word-search generator

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/word-search/

Build a seeded word-search puzzle from your own word list, with selectable directions, a printable grid and an answer key.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Create a twelve-by-twelve puzzle from eight animal names and print the solution separately.

## Limits and checks

English A–Z words are supported. A crowded grid may not fit every word; the tool tells you which entries need a larger grid.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
